style: Warm storybook 2D children's picture-book illustration, soft painterly texture, gentle rounded shapes, warm honey-yellow, leaf-green, sky-blue and cream palette, soft even lighting, friendly and calm. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, digits, logos, signatures, watermarks, UI buttons or frames.
spriteRule: Draw exactly ONE subject, whole and centred, filling about 80% of a square canvas, with a completely flat solid pure magenta background (#FF00FF) and no shadow on the background. Do not use magenta or purple anywhere on the subject.
backgroundRule: This is a background scene only. Keep the centre area calm, open and uncluttered (soft grass or sky), with detail only around the edges. No characters, no animals, no fruit or flowers that could be counted in the centre.
